body.en: Domain Restrictions, Invertibility & Asymptotic Behavior: An algebraic or transcendental function \(f: D \to R\) possesses an inverse \(f^{-1}: R \to D\) if and only if \(f\) is strictly one-to-one (bijective) on \(D\), guaranteeing that \(\text{dom}(f^{-1}) = \text{ran}(f)\) and \(\text{ran}(f^{-1}) = \text{dom}(f)\). For logarithmic and radical equations, every algebraic step that squares both sides or combines logs (\(\log_b u + \log_b v = \log_b(uv)\)) can enlarge the solution set, requiring a final domain check against the original equation.
body.ar: Domain Restrictions, Invertibility & Asymptotic Behavior: An algebraic or transcendental الدالة \(f: D \to R\) possesses an inverse \(f^{-1}: R \to D\) if and only if \(f\) is strictly one-to-one (bijective) on \(D\), guaranteeing that \(\text{dom}(f^{-1}) = \text{ran}(f)\) and \(\text{ran}(f^{-1}) = \text{dom}(f)\). For logarithmic and radical المعادلات, every algebraic step that squares both sides or combines logs (\(\log_b u + \log_b v = \log_b(uv)\)) can enlarge the الحل set, requiring a final المجال check against the original المعادلة.

body.en:
Why Completing the Square & Log-Linearization Work: Any quadratic \(f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c\) (\(a \ne 0\)) can be rewritten by factoring \(a\) from the first two terms and adding/subtracting \((b/2a)^2\):

\[ ax^2 + bx + c = a\!\left(x + \frac{b}{2a}\right)^2 + \left(c - \frac{b^2}{4a}\right) \]

Because \(\left(x + \frac{b}{2a}\right)^2 \ge 0\) for all \(x \in \mathbb{R}\), the extreme value \(k = c - \frac{b^2}{4a}\) is attained uniquely at the axis of symmetry \(x = -\frac{b}{2a}\), restricting the range to \([k, \infty)\) (if \(a > 0\)) and making \(f\) invertible on \(x \ge -\frac{b}{2a}\). Similarly, applying \(\ln\) to power laws \(y = ax^n\) yields \(\ln y = n\ln x + \ln a\), transforming a nonlinear curve into a straight line of gradient \(n\).

body.en:
Rationalize the denominator: \( \dfrac{6}{3 - \sqrt{3}} \).

Multiply numerator and denominator by the conjugate \( 3 + \sqrt{3} \):

\[ \frac{6(3 + \sqrt{3})}{(3 - \sqrt{3})(3 + \sqrt{3})} = \frac{18 + 6\sqrt{3}}{3^2 - (\sqrt{3})^2} = \frac{18 + 6\sqrt{3}}{9 - 3} = \frac{18 + 6\sqrt{3}}{6} = 3 + \sqrt{3}. \]

label.en: Common Pitfall — Splitting Radicals Over Addition & Extraneous Roots
label.ar: Common Pitfall — Splitting Radicals Over Addition & Extraneous Roots (الجذور والأسس الكسرية)

body.en: Two crucial rules for radicals: 1. Never split over addition: \( \sqrt{a^2 + b^2} \neq a + b \) (for example, \( \sqrt{9 + 16} = \sqrt{25} = 5 \), NOT \( 3 + 4 = 7 \)). You can only split radicals over multiplication and division. 2. Extraneous solutions: Squaring both sides of an equation can introduce false roots. You MUST substitute candidate solutions back into the original un-squared equation.
body.ar: Two crucial rules for radicals: 1. Never split over addition: \( \sqrt{a^2 + b^2} \neq a + b \) (for example, \( \sqrt{9 + 16} = \sqrt{25} = 5 \), NOT \( 3 + 4 = 7 \)). You can only split radicals over multiplication and division. 2. Extraneous الحلول: Squaring both sides of an المعادلة can introduce false roots. You MUST عوّض candidate الحلول back into the original un-squared المعادلة.

body.en:
Problem (Easy): Real numbers \( x \) and \( y \) satisfy \( x + y = 18 \) and \( xy = 56 \). Evaluate the squared difference \( f = (x - y)^2 \).

Step-by-Step Solution: Using \( (x - y)^2 = (x + y)^2 - 4xy \), we get \( 324 - 4(56) = 100 \).

Problem (Medium): A discrete exponential function satisfies \( f(x) = 25 \cdot 3^{x} \) for non-negative integers \( x \). Evaluate the value \( f(3) \).

question.en: Solve the equation \( \sqrt{2x + 7} = x + 2 \) for all real values of \( x \).
question.ar: حل المعادلة \( \sqrt{2x + 7} = x + 2 \) for all real values of \( x \).

solution.en:
Square both sides of the equation:

\[ (\sqrt{2x + 7})^2 = (x + 2)^2 \implies 2x + 7 = x^2 + 4x + 4. \]

Rearrange into standard quadratic form:

\[ x^2 + 2x - 3 = 0 \implies (x + 3)(x - 1) = 0 \implies x = 1 \quad \text{or} \quad x = -3. \]

Now check both candidate roots in the original equation:

  • For \( x = 1 \): LHS = \( \sqrt{2(1) + 7} = \sqrt{9} = 3 \); RHS = \( 1 + 2 = 3 \). (Valid ✓)
  • For \( x = -3 \): LHS = \( \sqrt{2(-3) + 7} = \sqrt{1} = 1 \); RHS = \( -3 + 2 = -1 \). Since \( 1 eq -1 \), \( x = -3 \) is extraneous.

The only real solution is \( x = 1 \).
solution.ar:
ربّع الطرفين of the equation:

\[ (\sqrt{2x + 7})^2 = (x + 2)^2 \implies 2x + 7 = x^2 + 4x + 4. \]

Rearrange into standard quadratic form:

\[ x^2 + 2x - 3 = 0 \implies (x + 3)(x - 1) = 0 \implies x = 1 \quad \text{or} \quad x = -3. \]

Now check both candidate roots in the original equation:

  • For \( x = 1 \): LHS = \( \sqrt{2(1) + 7} = \sqrt{9} = 3 \); RHS = \( 1 + 2 = 3 \). (Valid ✓)
  • For \( x = -3 \): LHS = \( \sqrt{2(-3) + 7} = \sqrt{1} = 1 \); RHS = \( -3 + 2 = -1 \). Since \( 1 eq -1 \), \( x = -3 \) is extraneous.

The only real solution is \( x = 1 \).

question.ar: بسّط العبارة and rationalize the denominator: \(\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{\sqrt{5} - \sqrt{2}}\).

solution.en:
Multiply numerator and denominator by the conjugate \(\sqrt{5} + \sqrt{2}\):

\[\frac{\sqrt{3}(\sqrt{5} + \sqrt{2})}{(\sqrt{5} - \sqrt{2})(\sqrt{5} + \sqrt{2})}.\]

Expand denominator using difference of squares \((a-b)(a+b) = a^2 - b^2\):

\[(\sqrt{5})^2 - (\sqrt{2})^2 = 5 - 2 = 3.\]

Expand numerator and simplify:

\[\frac{\sqrt{15} + \sqrt{6}}{3}.\]

\[(\sqrt{5})^2 - (\sqrt{2})^2 = 5 - 2 = 3.\]

\[\frac{\sqrt{15} + \sqrt{6}}{3}.\]

question.en: [Practice 3 · Hard] Let \(f(x) = \sqrt{x^2 - 4x + 4}\) and \(g(x) = \sqrt[3]{x^3 + 6x^2 + 12x + 8}\). If \(h(x) = f(x) \cdot g(x)\), find the value of \(h(-3)\).
question.ar: [Practice 3 · Hard] ليكن \(f(x) = \sqrt{x^2 - 4x + 4}\) and \(g(x) = \sqrt[3]{x^3 + 6x^2 + 12x + 8}\). إذا كان \(h(x) = f(x) \cdot g(x)\), أوجد قيمة \(h(-3)\).

hints.en: First, simplify the expressions for \(f(x)\) and \(g(x)\).
hints.ar: First, بسّط العبارة the expressions for \(f(x)\) and \(g(x)\).

hints.en: For \(f(x) = \sqrt{x^2 - 4x + 4}\), we recognize the expression inside the square root as a perfect square trinomial: \(x^2 - 4x + 4 = (x-2)^2\). Therefore, \(f(x) = \sqrt{(x-2)^2} = |x-2|\).
hints.ar: For \(f(x) = \sqrt{x^2 - 4x + 4}\), we recognize the expression inside the square root as a perfect square trinomial: \(x^2 - 4x + 4 = (x-2)^2\). وبالتالي، \(f(x) = \sqrt{(x-2)^2} = |x-2|\).
تلميح للحل: استخدم العلاقة \(h(-3)\) لتبسيط الخطوة.

solution.en:
First, simplify the expressions for \(f(x)\) and \(g(x)\).

For \(f(x) = \sqrt{x^2 - 4x + 4}\), we recognize the expression inside the square root as a perfect square trinomial: \(x^2 - 4x + 4 = (x-2)^2\).
Therefore, \(f(x) = \sqrt{(x-2)^2} = |x-2|\).

For \(g(x) = \sqrt[3]{x^3 + 6x^2 + 12x + 8}\), we recognize the expression inside the cube root as a perfect cube: \(x^3 + 6x^2 + 12x + 8 = (x+2)^3\).
Therefore, \(g(x) = \sqrt[3]{(x+2)^3} = x+2\).

Now, we can find the expression for \(h(x) = f(x) \cdot g(x)\).
\(h(x) = |x-2| \cdot (x+2)\).

We need to find the value of \(h(-3)\). Substitute \(x = -3\) into the expression for \(h(x)\).
\(h(-3) = |-3-2| \cdot (-3+2)\)
\(h(-3) = |-5| \cdot (-1)\)
\(h(-3) = 5 \cdot (-1)\)
\(h(-3) = -5\).

The value of \(h(-3)\) is -5.

For \(g(x) = \sqrt[3]{x^3 + 6x^2 + 12x + 8}\), we recognize the expression inside the cube root as a perfect cube: \(x^3 + 6x^2 + 12x + 8 = (x+2)^3\).
وبالتالي، \(g(x) = \sqrt[3]{(x+2)^3} = x+2\).

The value of \(h(-3)\) is -5.

question.en: [Practice 4 · Easy] Given the expression \( \sqrt[3]{64} \), what is the principal cube root of 64?
question.ar: حل المسألة التالية في (Radicals & Exponents): [Practice 4 · Easy] Given the expression \( \sqrt[3]{64} \), what is the principal cube root of 64?

hints.en: The cube root of a number 'x', denoted as \(\sqrt[3]{x}\), is a number 'y' such that \(y^3 = x\). We are looking for the number that, when multiplied by itself three times, equals 64. Let's test the options: - \(2^3 = 2 \times 2 \times 2\) (Incorrect).
hints.ar: The cube root of a number 'x', denoted as \(\sqrt[3]{x}\), is a number 'y' such that \(y^3 = x\). We are looking for the number that, عندما multiplied by itself three times, equals 64. ليكن's test the options: - \(2^3 = 2 \times 2 \times 2\) (Incorrect).
تلميح للحل: استخدم العلاقة \(4^3 = 4 \times 4 \times 4 = 16 \times 4 = 64\) ، \(8^3 = 8 \times 8 \times 8 = 64 \times 8 = 512\) ، \(16^3 = 16 \times 16 \times 16 = 256 \times 16\) لتبسيط الخطوة.

hints.en: Therefore, the principal cube root of 64 is 4.
hints.ar: وبالتالي، the principal cube root of 64 is 4.

solution.en:
The cube root of a number 'x', denoted as \(\sqrt[3]{x}\), is a number 'y' such that \(y^3 = x\). We are looking for the number that, when multiplied by itself three times, equals 64. Let's test the options:

- \(2^3 = 2 \times 2 \times 2 = 8\) (Incorrect)
- \(4^3 = 4 \times 4 \times 4 = 16 \times 4 = 64\) (Correct)
- \(8^3 = 8 \times 8 \times 8 = 64 \times 8 = 512\) (Incorrect)
- \(16^3 = 16 \times 16 \times 16 = 256 \times 16 = 4096\) (Incorrect)

Therefore, the principal cube root of 64 is 4.

label.en: ● Master Atlas of the 9 Main Parent Functions & Universal Transformation Law
label.ar: ● الأطلس الشامل للدوال الأم التسع وقانون التحويلات الهندسية العام

body.en:
Every algebraic and elementary transcendental model is built by transforming one of the nine core parent functions via \(g(x) = a\,f(x - h) + k\), where \(|a|\) scales vertically (reflecting across the \(x\)-axis if \(a < 0\)), \(h\) shifts horizontally, and \(k\) shifts vertically:

FamilyTransformed Form \(g(x)\)DomainRange (\(a > 0\))Key Geometric Feature
Constant\(f(x) = c\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\{c\}\)Horizontal line, slope \(0\)
Linear\(a(x - h) + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Constant slope \(m = a\), pivot \((h, k)\)
Quadratic\(a(x - h)^2 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)Parabola vertex \((h, k)\), axis \(x = h\)
Cubic\(a(x - h)^3 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Inflection center \((h, k)\), S-curve
Absolute Value\(a|x - h| + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)V-corner vertex \((h, k)\), slopes \(\pm a\)
Radical\(a\sqrt{x - h} + k\)\([h, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)Endpoint \((h, k)\), half-parabola
Rational\(\dfrac{a}{x - h} + k\)\(x \neq h\)\(y \neq k\)Vertical asymptote \(x = h\), horizontal \(y = k\)
Exponential\(a \cdot 2^{x - h} + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((k, \infty)\)Horizontal asymptote \(y = k\), anchor \((h, a+k)\)
Logarithmic\(a\ln(x - h) + k\)\((h, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Vertical asymptote \(x = h\), anchor \((h+1, k)\)
body.ar:
تُبنى النماذج الجبرية والمتسامية الأساسية من خلال تطبيق التحويل القياسي \(g(x) = a\,f(x - h) + k\) على إحدى الدوال الأم التسع، حيث يتحكم \(|a|\) في التمدد الرأسي (مع انعكاس حول محور السينات إذا كان \(a < 0\))، ويمثل \(h\) الإزاحة الأفقية، و\(k\) الإزاحة الرأسية:

عائلة الدالةالصورة المحوّلة \(g(x)\)المجالالمدى (\(a > 0\))السمة الهندسية المميزة
الثابتة\(f(x) = c\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\{c\}\)مستقيم أفقي ميله \(0\)
الخطية\(a(x - h) + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)ميل ثابت \(m = a\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h, k)\)
التربيعية\(a(x - h)^2 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)قطع مكافئ رأسه \((h, k)\) ومحوره \(x = h\)
التكعيبية\(a(x - h)^3 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)نقطة انعطاف مركزية \((h, k)\)
القيمة المطلقة\(a|x - h| + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)رأس زاوي على شكل V عند \((h, k)\) بميلين \(\pm a\)
الجذرية\(a\sqrt{x - h} + k\)\([h, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)نقطة بداية \((h, k)\) ومجال مقيّد \(x \ge h\)
النسبية (المقلوب)\(\dfrac{a}{x - h} + k\)\(x \neq h\)\(y \neq k\)تقارب رأسي \(x = h\) وتقارب أفقي \(y = k\)
الأسية\(a \cdot 2^{x - h} + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((k, \infty)\)تقارب أفقي \(y = k\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h, a+k)\)
اللوغاريتمية\(a\ln(x - h) + k\)\((h, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)تقارب رأسي \(x = h\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h+1, k)\)
